text: Great Bronze Cannon Source Guns & Gears (Remastered) pg. 176 Price 12,000 gp Ammunition scattershot barrels (25 gp, 5 Bulk) --- Usage mounted (black powder) Space 18 feet long, 7 feet wide, 8 feet high Crew 4-6 Proficiency martial --- AC 32 Fort +26 Ref +18 Hardness 15 HP 200 Immunities object immunities --- Speed 10 feet (pushed or pulled) --- This great bronze cannon is one of the largest pieces of mobile artillery ever deployed, though its immense weight limits just how mobile it actually is. The barrel of a great bronze cannon is nearly 3 feet in diameter, making it impractical to manufacture and handle cannonballs of sufficient size. Instead, great bronze cannons spray buckshot in a similar way to blunderbusses, firing large barrels that break apart mid-flight and release a rain of scattershot over a massive area. The slow movement and short range make this siege weapon fit fewer situations than most, but when used effectively, such as to stop a charge of mutants against a city’s walls, the results are devastating. Aim Three Actions 50 feet, minimum distance 50 feet Load Three Actions (manipulate) 3 times, requires a successful DC 20 Athletics check Launch Two Actions (manipulate, range increment 50 feet) 10d12 bludgeoning, 50-foot burst, DC 33 Reflex

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 176 **Price** 12,000 gp **Ammunition** scattershot barrels (25 gp, 5 Bulk) --- **Usage** mounted (black powder) **Space** 18 feet long, 7 feet wide, 8 feet high **Crew** 4-6 **Proficiency** martial --- **AC** 32 **Fort** +26 **Ref** +18 **Hardness** 15 **HP** 200 **Immunities** object immunities --- **Speed** 10 feet (pushed or pulled) --- This great bronze cannon is one of the largest pieces of mobile artillery ever deployed, though its immense weight limits just how mobile it actually is. The barrel of a great bronze cannon is nearly 3 feet in diameter, making it impractical to manufacture and handle cannonballs of sufficient size. Instead, great bronze cannons spray buckshot in a similar way to [blunderbusses](/Weapons.aspx?ID=196), firing large barrels that break apart mid-flight and release a rain of scattershot over a massive area. The slow movement and short range make this siege weapon fit fewer situations than most, but when used effectively, such as to stop a charge of mutants against a city’s walls, the results are devastating.
**Aim** 50 feet, minimum distance 50 feet
**Load** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) 3 times, requires a successful DC 20 [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check
**Launch** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [range increment 50 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)) 10d12 bludgeoning, 50-foot burst, DC 33 Reflex
